description: This file handles downloading and processing of Microsoft Teams message attachments, including resolving download candidates, handling inline images, and managing authenticated fetch requests.

methods.name: resolveDownloadCandidate
methods.description: Resolves an MSTeamsAttachmentLike object into a DownloadCandidate with URL, hints, and placeholder.

methods.name: scopeCandidatesForUrl
methods.description: Determines OAuth scope candidates based on the URL's hostname.

methods.name: isRedirectStatus
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates a redirect.

methods.name: fetchWithAuthFallback
methods.description: Performs fetch with OAuth token fallback on 401/403 responses, handling redirects.

methods.name: downloadMSTeamsAttachments
methods.description: Downloads all file attachments from a Teams message, including inline images and remote media.
